name: cauce-server-web
description: Web UI toolchain for cauce-server: the Svelte 5 SPA under web/src/spa/ builds via vite into assets/spa/ (rust-embed, served at /app); svelte-check drives the classic typescript@6 API internally and tsgo (--tsgo) for diagnostics, native tsc typechecks the non-Svelte trees (src/types, src/i18n, tests), and vitest + happy-dom unit-tests them. FX-06 removed the framework-free src/ bundle and the htmx deps.
